 "content": "from collections import Counter, deque


def transform(grid):
    """Fill each hollow rectangular frame according to its interior parity."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = set()
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.add((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen
                            and grid[yy][xx] == color):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y, x in cells), max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y, x in cells), max(x for y, x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            # Confirm that the component is precisely the perimeter of a rectangle.
            perimeter = ({(r0, x) for x in range(c0, c1+1)} |
                         {(r1, x) for x in range(c0, c1+1)} |
                         {(y, c0) for y in range(r0, r1+1)} |
                         {(y, c1) for y in range(r0, r1+1)})
            if cells != perimeter:
                continue
            inside_h, inside_w = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
            fill = 7 if inside_h % 2 else 2
            for y in range(r0+1, r1):
                for x in range(c0+1, c1):
                    if grid[y][x] == background:
                        out[y][x] = fill
    return out
"
}
